posts.name: McBehrer
posts.cooked: Do whatever seems most reasonable to you. I would say it is isolated from the deck, and therefore would not get drawn.

posts.name: Killswitch
posts.cooked: I would certainly say it leaves the deck, and it would form a stack of actions. That's how I would do it. So similarly how you would resolve multiple villian plays in order, you would move from one recompile to another in order, without keeping them in the deck. I'd just move both to the same play area as one-shots.

posts.name: arenson9
posts.cooked: I think a revealed card is one that has left the deck but not landed anywhere else yet. It doesn't have a location. It's not in a deck. It's not  in play. It's not in a hand. It's not in a trash. It is still in the game.
posts.raw: I think a revealed card is one that has left the deck but not landed anywhere else yet. It doesn't have a location. It's not in a deck. It's not  in play. It's not in a hand. It's not in a trash. It is still in the game.
